testsuite.name: org.thoughtcrime.securesms.jobs.PreKeysSyncJobTest

testcase.name: when forcePniSignedPreKeyRotation flag set, PNI sync runs forced and ACI does not
when flag not set, no PNI force and flag write is skipped
when forcePniSignedPreKeyRotation flag set but uploads fail, flag is preserved
flag set forces PNI rotation even when consistency check passes and time gate would skip
